title: Buried interface modification for high performance and stable perovskite solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,3659-3667
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05466K, Paper
Yang Cao, Li Yang, Nan Yan, Lanxiang Meng, Xin Chen, Jiafan Zhang, Danyang Qi, Jiacheng Pi, Nan Li, Xiaolong Feng, Chuang Ma, Fengwei Xiao, Guangtao Zhao, Shuwen Tan, Xiaoyan Liu, Yucheng Liu, Kui Zhao, Shengzhong (Frank) Liu, Jiangshan Feng
Phenylhydrazinium chloride (PC) is used as the buried interface modification material of a perovskite film to passivate defects and retard the crystallization process of perovskite films, resulting in improved PCE from 24.67% to 25.80%.
